data.title: They run, box and crash: inside the jaw-dropping world robot games - Futura-Sciences
data.description: High Speed, World Records, and a Sprinkle of Calamity Imagine this: a Chinese humanoid robot sprints 100 meters in just 9.39 seconds, smashing Usain Bolt’s legendary record of 9.58 seconds. But before you call for a new Olympics, know that this metallic sprinter had a dramatic finish—crashing straight into safety...
data.author: Futura Team
